notes.title: PATCH 1.7 Smooth Camera and Parallax
notes.notes:
Hi! Last week someone wrote me that he got motion sick playing the game. So I did some research into how people who are prone to motion sickness respond to the way characters move, how backgrounds move, and how the two move together. As a result now you can play with a smooth camera and parallax. I hope you all enjoy the improvement :)

On another front, during the last months I have been publishing on facebook a lot of stuff about The Purring Quest (early concepts, rejected animations of Kimchi, details about donations, etc). Don't forget to like the page to keep up to date!: [url=https://www.facebook.com/valhallacats/] Facebook[/url]

[img]http://www.valhallacats.com/wp-content/uploads/12916106_528694433969223_280217289848648155_o.jpg[/img]

notes.title: PATCH 1.4 Double Jump!
notes.notes:
Double Jump!

Here you have the new update including one of the most demanded features by all of you: a new type of easier control based in double jump!

We know that a lot of people have enjoyed The Purring Quest with the original controls so we want to keep them and offer you the new one. 

We would love to know your opinion because it will help us to improve the new video games we will make. What type of control do you like the best?

[img]http://www.valhallacats.com/wp-content/uploads/ControlTypeHD.png[/img]

[Note] If your version is earlier than 1.3 you have to Start a New Game. Don't click [i]Continue[/i] before clicking [i]New Game[/i] button.

notes.title: PATCH 1.3
notes.notes:
Achievements, improved jumps and minor fixes

The new update generates a different savefile so you have to [b]start a New Game[/b]. Once the new savefile is created you can play as always and unlock the achievement. [u]Don't click Continue before clicking New Game button[/u].

* Achievements!
* Adjustement in kimchi's colliders. Now the jumps are more accurate.
* The tutorial shows keys and xbox360 buttons. 
* Minor fixes.

[img]http://www.valhallacats.com/wp-content/uploads/logros.png[/img]


I hope you enjoy the new update!

notes.notes:
More responsible controls and minor fixes

* More responsible controls
* The double-punish for missing a key in the piano minigame is fixed
* Adjustments in dog's speed
* The fog returns to the graveyard level
* Fixed minor grammar errors
* Dozens of minor fixes and tweaks in the difficulty

I want you all happy with controls before continue with achievement ;)

notes.title: PATCH 1.1
notes.notes:
Better control and  difficulty adjustments 

* Kimchi is a little more agile
* Fixed problem with the first final boss colliders
* The bosses can be defeated when revisiting a level
* The final chase is now easier
* Fixed minor grammar errors
* Dozens of minor fixes and tweaks in the difficulty


Future plans:

* Better controller support
* Achievements
* More Languages
* Linux version
* Mac version

Please feel free to leave your comments :)
 
Currently I am the only person working on the studio so please be patient.

ENJOY!
